paragraphs.text: At the start of this century, record companies treated vinyl as a product for collectors only. Most music was bought on CDs or, increasingly, downloaded, and several factories that pressed records closed down.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Since then, sales of new vinyl records have risen every year for more than a decade. Surveys suggest that many buyers are young people who also use streaming services and who had never owned a record player before.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Buyers give various reasons for choosing an older format. Some say that records sound warmer, although listening tests have not shown that most people can hear a difference. More often, buyers mention the pleasure of owning a physical object with large artwork.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The revival has caused practical problems. Because so few factories remained, new records can take months to manufacture, and small bands sometimes wait so long that their album is released after their tour has finished.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Some observers doubt that the trend will last. Vinyl still represents only a small share of total music income, and rising material costs have pushed prices up, which may discourage the younger buyers who drove the growth.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: record companies treated vinyl as a product for collectors only

explanation.en: Vinyl was seen as “for collectors only” and factories closed → i. Heading vii catches “CDs”, but the paragraph does not say CDs are popular now.
explanation.kk: Винилді «for collectors only» тауар деп санаған, зауыттар жабылған → i. vii тақырыбы «CDs» сөзіне ілінеді, бірақ абзац CD қазір танымал деп айтпайды.
explanation.ru: Винил считали товаром «for collectors only», заводы закрывались → i. Заголовок vii ловит «CDs», но абзац не утверждает, что CD сейчас популярны.

items.quote: many buyers are young people who also use streaming services

explanation.en: The point of B is who buys: “many buyers are young people” → iii. Streaming is mentioned, but not how musicians are paid (vi).
explanation.kk: B-дағы басты ой — кім сатып алады: «many buyers are young people» → iii. Streaming аталады, бірақ музыканттарға қалай төлейтіні (vi) айтылмайды.
explanation.ru: Главное в B — кто покупает: «many buyers are young people» → iii. Streaming упомянут, но не то, как платят музыкантам (vi).

items.quote: buyers mention the pleasure of owning a physical object with large artwork

explanation.en: Two reasons to buy: sound (“sound warmer”) and owning “a physical object” → v, which names both.
explanation.kk: Сатып алудың екі себебі: дыбыс («sound warmer») және затқа ие болу қуанышы («a physical object») — екеуін де атайтын тақырып → v.
explanation.ru: Две причины покупки: звук («sound warmer») и радость владения вещью («a physical object») → v, который называет обе.

items.quote: new records can take months to manufacture

explanation.en: The practical problem is slow production: “new records can take months to manufacture” → ii.
explanation.kk: Практикалық мәселе — ұзақ өндіріс: «new records can take months to manufacture» → ii.
explanation.ru: Практическая проблема — долгое производство: «new records can take months to manufacture» → ii.

items.quote: Some observers doubt that the trend will last.
keywords: doubt that the trend will last

explanation.en: “Some observers doubt that the trend will last”, followed by the reasons: a small share of income and rising prices → iv.
explanation.kk: «Some observers doubt that the trend will last» — әрі қарай күмәннің себептері: табыстағы аз үлес пен бағаның өсуі → iv.
explanation.ru: «Some observers doubt that the trend will last» — дальше причины сомнений: малая доля дохода и рост цен → iv.

Doubts about the future of the trend
Sound quality or the appeal of an object
The invention of the record player

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The reading passage has five paragraphs, A–E. Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings below. Write the correct number, i–viii.
